gameDescriptionHtml:
Roll out for intense arcade racing and robot combat, fused together in a battle for the lost Prime Relics. Cybertron’s future depends on you!

Game Features

  • CHOOSE YOUR SIDE – Stop Nemesis Prime as an Autobot or Decepticon. Roll out for an intense fusion of arcade racing and robot combat in TRANSFORMERS: Galactic Trials! Evil NEMESIS PRIME has stolen the Prime Relics that bestow incredible powers on whoever possesses them. Now the AUTOBOTS and DECEPTICONS are in an explosive race to recover these powerful artifacts – which side will you fight for?
  • BATTLE TO THE FINISH – Compete in a frenetic fusion of racing and combat. Choose your character from icons like BUMBLEBEE, MEGATRON, and OPTIMUS PRIME, and speed into action on ten battle-race circuits.
  • LEVEL YOUR CHARACTER – Level up and customize 11 iconic Transformers. Pull off sick drifts, charge your way through Boost Pads, and build up your Energon meter as you try to outpace your rivals.
  • SPEED TO VICTORY – Drift and boost around 10 action-packed tracks then convert into bot-mode and unleash devastating Energon-fueled skills, including OPTIMUS PRIME’s Energon Axe and BUMBLEBEE’s Plasma Sting, to fight your opponents to the finish line. As you gain experience and recover the powerful Prime Relics, you’ll build your skills and unlock new characters and skins.
  • LOCAL MULTIPLAYER – Battle-race a friend in Versus mode. This is more than a race and bigger than any battle. It’s the ultimate test of your favorite TRANSFORMERS’ robot abilities, which will decide the future of Cybertron!
